title: Protocol PDF: render the hwdesk_protocol template with dompdf, store under private://hwdesk/protocols

final class ProtocolPdf. Asset or user missing -> \InvalidArgumentException.
store(Handover $handover): \Drupal\file\FileInterface -- protocol number empty -> \InvalidArgumentException. Destination 'private://hwdesk/protocols/<protocol_number>.pdf'; $fileSystem->prepareDirectory($dir, FileSystemInterface::CREATE_DIRECTORY | FileSystemInterface::MODIFY_PERMISSIONS) first; $file = $fileRepository->writeData($this->render($handover), $destination, \Drupal\Core\File\FileExists::Replace); $file->setPermanent(); $file->setMimeType('application/pdf'); $file->save(); return $file.
